name: Connla (Conla, Conlaí, Conle)

attributes.attribute: the place that draws the heroes

sources: Monaghan, Patricia. The Encyclopedia of Celtic Mythology and Folklore. Checkmark Books, 2008.
text: The record gathers the Adventures, tales of men of this world pulled into the Otherworld. In the Adventure of Connla, a fairy woman draws the youth across. In the Adventure of Cormac, the king is gripped by enchantment music that sends him off in pursuit of a lover in that realm. In the Adventure of Laoghaire, the king works to free the spouse of an Otherworldly friend.

okr.objective: The record covers tales of heroes lured to the Otherworld.
key_results: A fairy woman lures Connla away.
Cormac is drawn by fairy music.
okr.evidence: Monaghan, Encyclopedia of Celtic Mythology and Folklore
